messages:
elaine: Rapid design check: alternate compare row layout where badges are left-aligned and metrics expand on hover: https://www.figma.com/file/aaaaa/compare-left-badges
matt: looks promising. left-aligned badges improve scan for power users. question: how does that affect row height with long model names? we should clamp names to 2 lines and show full name on hover
jorge: accessibility: if tooltip shows on hover, also ensure it appears on focus. tooltips for metrics should be accessible via aria-describedby with id on the metric element
accessibility-bot: Flag: ensure tooltip content is reachable by keyboard and aria is present
elaine: microcopy: replace "v1.2-stable" style with "v1.2 (stable)" for clarity in small spaces
matt: pin UX: earlier threads suggested a sticky pinned area. also consider a "compare favorites" view that persists across sessions and can be toggled in header
jorge: that could be a separate list saved to user preferences. ensure export/import is possible for team sharing
elaine: quick question: when the pinned strip is visible and user scrolls to table, should the strip overlap content or push it down? overlapping can be problematic with sticky headers for screen readers
matt: push content down by default, but allow a compact overlay mode in settings for power users
jorge: also add a live region update when pinned strip visibility changes: "Pinned versions bar added. 2 pinned items" so screen reader users know
elaine: small CSS for badge text to increase legibility on colored backgrounds:
```css
.badge {font-weight:600;color:var(--badge-foreground)}
```
matt: on filter summary: recommend a "Clear all" affordance inside the summary panel and a quick "Undo" toast when filters are cleared for safety
elaine: undo toast should include keyboard shortcut hint "Ctrl+Z" if available and be announced via aria-live polite
accessibility-bot: Added checklist entries: tooltip focusable, aria-describedby, live region for pinned bar, clear-all undo toast announced
elaine: thanks all. I'll update mocks and add notes to the component doc. will post updated link later :wave:
